problem.observed: The reviewed three-line Step 0.5 block was pasted into the iPhone Codespaces terminal with a line boundary collapsed, producing a bash syntax error before the required PASS marker.
problem.security_effect: No Step 1/2/3/4 continuation is permitted because PHASE_C_TRUSTED_PYTHON_BINDING_PASS was not emitted. Retyping or reformatting inside the consumed one-shot session would be operator invention.

remediation_scope.principle: Replace only the Step 0.5 multiline transport form with a frozen single-line shell equivalent so iPhone paste does not depend on newline preservation.

exact_v5_overrides.step0_5_python_binding_check_single_line:
test -x '/usr/local/python/current/bin/python' || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRUSTED_PYTHON_BINARY_MISSING_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 89; }; test "$(command -v python)" = '/usr/local/python/current/bin/python' || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRUSTED_PYTHON_RESOLUTION_MISMATCH_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 89; }; command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRUSTED_PYTHON_BINDING_PASS'
exact_v5_overrides.delivery_rule: Paste this exact single line once at the bash-5.2 clean-shell prompt. Do not split, edit, retype, or compose it interactively.
exact_v5_overrides.all_other_steps: V4 Step 0, Step 1, Step 2 OAuth, post-OAuth clean-shell reentry/rehydration, Step 3 and Step 4 remain unchanged.
